attchmntText: Innovision Limited has informed the Exchange about Awarding of order(s)/contract(s)
voiceSummary: Innovision Limited received a Letter of Award from the National Highways Authority of India on 13.11.2026 for user fee collection at Patnipartapur Toll Plaza on NH-709A in Uttar Pradesh and maintenance of adjacent toilet blocks. The contract was awarded through competitive e-tendering with tender ID NHAI/13013/547/CO/26-27/ (1.641)/EQ/Patnipartapur Fee Plaza/E214618/N-2196. The order value is 10,99,79,910 rupees. The execution period is 90 days. The entity awarding the order is domestic. The contract does not involve related party transactions or interest from the promoter group. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Innovision Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Innovision Limited submitted newspaper advertisements to the BSE and NSE on 14th November 2026. These advertisements were published pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The publication relates to the outcome of the Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. During this meeting, the Board approved and took on record the Unaudited Financial Results. These results cover both Standalone and Consolidated figures. The period under review is the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The advertisements appeared in Financial Express and Jansatta.

attchmntText: Innovision Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Innovision Limited filed a statement of deviations and variations regarding the utilization of funds raised through its Initial Public Offer on 23rd March 2026. The company raised gross proceeds of 2,550 Million and net proceeds of 2097.99 Million. The report covers the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of funds. The monitoring agency is CRISIL Ratings Limited. Funds were allocated for repayment of borrowings, working capital requirements, and general corporate purposes. For repayment of borrowings, the original allocation was 510.00 Million, with 510.00 Million utilized. For working capital, the allocation was 1,190.00 Million, with 824.91 Million utilized. For general corporate purposes, the allocation was 397.99 Million, with 1.36 Million utilized. No utilization occurred for general corporate purposes during the reported quarter.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Innovision Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the BSE and NSE. The report, dated 13th November 2026, was issued by CRISIL Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of the company's Initial Public Offer proceeds. The draft report was reviewed by the Audit Committee during its meeting held on 13th November 2026. This filing is submitted pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The document serves as information and record for the exchanges.

attchmntText: Innovision Limited has informed the Exchange about a change in accounting estimate relating to the pattern of consumption of the right to collect toll under the Company's contracts with the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI). The revision has been undertaken in accordance with IND AS 8, Accounting Policies, Changes in Accounting Estimates and Errors, as the Management considers the revised basis more appropriate in reflecting the pattern of consumption of the right to collect toll, considering the seasonal and periodic variations in vehicular movement on toll roads.
voiceSummary: Innovision Limited approved a change in accounting estimate relating to toll collection rights with the National Highways Authority of India. The Board revised the recognition basis for fees payable to NHAI from a straight-line method to a proportionate basis relative to estimated monthly vehicular traffic. This change applies prospectively from July 01, 2026, in accordance with IND AS 8. The revision aims to better reflect seasonal variations in traffic. For the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, the change decreased toll fee expense by ₹23.76 Crores. This resulted in a corresponding increase in profit before tax by ₹23.76 Crores. The total contractual fees payable to NHAI remain unchanged. The Board meeting concluded at 05:00 PM on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Innovision Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results alongwith Limited Review Report for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Innovision Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board received a Limited Review Report from statutory auditors SR G A & Co. stating no material misstatements were found. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 3,560.87 million, with a profit before tax of 47.70 million. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 6,198.73 million, resulting in a loss before tax of 50.87 million. The company revised its accounting estimate for toll fees under NHAI contracts effective July 1, 2026, recognizing expenses based on estimated vehicular traffic rather than a straight-line basis. This change reduced toll fee expense by 2237.63 million for the quarter. Cash and cash equivalents stood at 159.73 million as of September 30, 2026.

voiceSummary: Innovision Limited received a Letter of Award from the National Highways Authority of India on 10.11.2026. The company was selected as the user fee agency for the Shamli to Muzzafarnagar section of National Highway 709AD in Uttar Pradesh. The scope includes upkeep and maintenance of adjacent toilet blocks and recouping consumable items. The contract was awarded through competitive bidding via E-Tender. The order value is Rs. 12,16,79,910. The execution period is 90 days. The entity awarding the order is domestic. The contract does not involve related party transactions. Promoters have no interest in the awarding entity. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
